idea: NotariaFlow AI: AI copilot for small/medium notary firms to accelerate document preparation with reviewable extraction and automated drafts.

selected_gap.title: Revisable AI Notarial Extraction
selected_gap.pain: Notaries fear AI errors that can have legal consequences; they spend excessive time manually verifying AI output, negating efficiency gains.
selected_gap.why_now: AI/NLP advanced enough for high-accuracy extraction, but trust remains a barrier; no competitor offers an explainable, reviewable AI layer tailored to notarial acts.
selected_gap.evidence_needed: Build prototype with highlighted extracted fields, confidence scores, and an editing interface; conduct user tests with 5 notaries, measure verification time reduction and trust scores.
selected_gap.risk: Direct competitor LexNotari could add explainability features quickly; regulatory uncertainty about AI usage in legally binding documents.

decision: Proceed with building the prototype and conducting user tests as specified in the gap evidence. Reassess after achieving milestones.
next_experiments: Develop a minimum viable prototype with OCR and LLM extraction, highlighting fields and confidence scores.
Conduct user tests with 5 notaries, measuring verification time and trust scores.
Interview 20 notaries to validate pain intensity and willingness to pay.
Analyze competitors (e.g., LexNotari) for feature gaps and potential responses.
kill_criteria: After user tests, verification time reduction is less than 20% or average trust score is below 3/5.
No notary expresses willingness to pay >$50/month after prototype demo.
A major incumbent launches a similar explainable feature within 6 months.
_iteration_one_liner: Automatizamos la extracción y validación de datos para borradores notariales con IA revisable, ahorrando horas de trabajo manual y eliminando errores en firmas pequeñas y medianas.
